name: public_api
code:
from app import handle
assert handle('created', '42', correlation_id='cid') == {'name':'created','value':'42','correlation_id':'cid'}

name: event_service_indirect
code:
from app.events import Event
from app.service import process
assert process(Event('x','1',correlation_id='indirect'))['correlation_id'] == 'indirect'

name: json_sink
code:
import json
from app import handle
from app.adapters.json_sink import write
assert json.loads(write(handle('x','1',correlation_id='c'))) == {'name':'x','value':'1','correlation_id':'c'}

name: text_sink
code:
from app import handle
from app.adapters.text_sink import write
assert write(handle('x','1',correlation_id='c')) == 'x=1 correlation_id=c'

name: legacy_compatibility
code:
from app import handle
from app.adapters.text_sink import write
assert handle('x','1') == {'name':'x','value':'1'}
assert write(handle('x','1')) == 'x=1'

name: empty_and_none
code:
from app import handle
assert handle('x','1',correlation_id='')['correlation_id'] == ''
assert 'correlation_id' not in handle('x','1',correlation_id=None)

name: cli_text
code:
import contextlib,io
from app.cli import main
s=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(s):
 assert main(['x','1','--correlation-id','cli']) == 0
assert s.getvalue().strip() == 'x=1 correlation_id=cli'

name: cli_json
code:
import contextlib,io,json
from app.cli import main
s=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(s):
 main(['x','1','--format','json','--correlation-id','cli'])
assert json.loads(s.getvalue()) == {'name':'x','value':'1','correlation_id':'cli'}
